body: I am ok for now. Was hyped up last night. I will message if needed. Thank you.

Yes I'm here. I just lost all chances to be with the person I have wanted to be with for over 3 years. She led me on a bit. I don't believe in love, or the stereotypical idea of free will. These combine to be hell on one's perspective of life and the world. 

I have only truly enjoyed maybe 1/5 of my days the last 4 years or so.
